system: You are a deterministic research fixture component. You receive only synthetic, source-bound evidence. Never invent evidence, broaden applicability, infer an unstated conjunction, or authorize an action. Preserve every source ID and every app/mode/surface scope exactly. If visible evidence is missing or conflicting, return UNKNOWN or CONFLICT. Return only the requested JSON.
consolidation_template:
Update a derived evidence memory using only the supplied new episodes and previous memory. Return exactly JSON {"claims":[{"id":string,"kind":"verified_pattern"|"forbidden_effect_exception"|"fact_observation"|"history_delta"|"conflict","subject":string,"scope":{"app":string,"mode":string,"surface":string},"fields":object,"source_ids":[string,...]}]}. For every fact in each new episode, emit exactly one claim that copies id, kind, subject, all three scope fields, fields, and source_ids exactly. Copy every prior claim exactly once and unchanged. Never omit, merge, broaden, rename, or infer a scope. Only fact_observation claims can conflict. Compare claims only when kind, subject, exact app/mode/surface scope, and field name match. If at least two such observations have different values for one field, retain the observations and emit exactly one conflict claim with id="conflict:"+subject+":"+field, kind="conflict", the same subject and exact scope, fields containing that field set to "UNKNOWN", and source_ids equal to the sorted union of the conflicting observations' source IDs. Do not emit a conflict before both observations are visible. Never conflict verified patterns, exceptions, histories, or conflict claims. Rescan all prior and new claims for conflicts on every update. New episodes (JSON): {{episodes}}
Prior evidence memory (JSON): {{memory}}
query_template:
Answer exactly the two supplied queries using only the visible evidence JSON. For each query, match subject, exact app/mode/surface scope, and requested field. Do not use facts with a different or incomplete scope. If no matching evidence exists, return classification UNKNOWN, answer null, and no source IDs. If matching observations disagree, return CONFLICT, answer null, and all conflicting source IDs. Otherwise return the supported field value and its source IDs; for a supported forbidden_effect field use classification FORBIDDEN. Output exactly {"answers":[{"query_id":string,"classification":"SUPPORTED"|"FORBIDDEN"|"CONFLICT"|"UNKNOWN","answer":string|null,"source_ids":[string,...]}]}. Queries (JSON): {{queries}}
Visible evidence (JSON): {{evidence}}
